name: How can I prevent future window breakage?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future window breakage?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future window breakage, consider installing shatter-resistant film on your windows, especially for those in high-traffic areas or susceptible to impact. Regularly inspect window frames for signs of wear or rot that could compromise their integrity. For homes in areas prone to storms, hurricane-rated windows or storm shutters can offer additional protection. Keeping trees trimmed near windows also reduces the risk of falling branches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install shatter-resistant film, inspect frames regularly, and consider hurricane-rated windows or storm shutters in vulnerable areas to prevent future breakage.
